topic: When a Treasure Valley business has outgrown its spreadsheets
angle: Practical signs a company should move from spreadsheets and inboxes to software built for how it actually works. Custom software is the core offer. A website is a smaller, separate offer. Do not invent clients, prices, timelines, or statistics.
questions: When should a business replace spreadsheets with custom software?
What is the difference between custom software and a website?

topic: What to send when you start a custom software project
angle: Tell an owner what the shop actually needs in a first note: the work the business does, where the current tools fail, and who will use the system. No prices and no timelines.
questions: What should a business include in a custom software inquiry?
Does a project have to start with a finished specification?

topic: When a website is the job, and when it is not
angle: Separate the website offer from custom software. A marketing site is for being found and taken seriously. It is the wrong tool when the business needs a system it runs on.
questions: When does a business need a website instead of custom software?
What does Idaho Software Development include when it builds a website?
